pair_details.prompt_text: A widower's best friend died. 18 months later he's having lunch with the widow.
`` Do you have it? '' `` Here. '' `` That's not what I asked for! '' `` But it's what you need. '' Give this ambiguous dialog context in a story! Any genre!
Everyone has Basic Income and you just quit your job. They said, *Follow your dreams!: ) *
Dreams are a manifestation of your desires whether they are overt, subconscious, or otherwise. Tell me of the man who does not dream.
An epic battle between a gardener and some seemingly harmless garden weeds
You are a lucid dreamer with a very dangerous reality test.

In a moment of crisis, for just one hour, your protagonist is granted the power that anyone they command wil do whatever they ask, even if it is normally physically impossible. Tell the tale of this miraculous hour, and/or its consequences.
[ CW ] - Write a story that ends with `` After all, such things do not come easily. ''
Write an argument between God and Lucifer as an old married couple.
you're an artist, but every once in a while a random drawing you make comes to life, the tools you used to create the drawing and the emotions you felt while creating it, affect its personality.
A piece of paper being made in China and taking a journey across factories, shipping, and being put in a city store to ending up in a back alley of a major city ( any ).
after death, any smoker sent to heaven must pick up every cigarette butt they threw on the ground before they can get in.
After the rapture, a lone atheist discovers that they are the only person that ever lived to make the cut.
She wore the scar around her throat like a fine ruby necklace.
( WP ) A Harriett Tubman story but different situation/character
Indentured servitude is alive and well in the modern-day US, and with it, gladiatorial combat is often chosen as a method to clear debts.
Help! You've fallen and can't get up. When you call 911, they don't answer. Why isn't 911 answering?
After many years, the Gods awaken. Now they must reintegrate into society and become valued members of the community. You have been appointed to help them achieve this.
There are dragons living among us, disguised. But when you look into it further, it turns out that you are the only human in a neighborhood of dragons.
Death stands before you, claiming your time has come to an end. However, you are allowed to choose exactly how you die. Fortunately, you are a slick lawyer and trick death in living forever.
You sit at a bus stop and ask the person sitting besides you when the last bus is due, ( s ) he simply laughs...
The Christ and the antichrist meet by chance. Neither knows who the other is.

You have the ability/curse to return a day back in the past whenever someone close to you dies. You are currently stuck in an endless loop where you can't save your best friend from dying no matter how hard you try and you are going insane, until...
You've been surviving for years on the wasteland following the earth's destruction. One day, you spot someone carrying a sign. It reads `` The Beginning is Nigh ''.
While walking down the street, suddenly everyone around you freeze. A large red `` You have lost the connection to the server '' appears on the sky.
Let's write a story together. There exists a woman, 27 years old, college educated, working an unfulfilling, low paying job. Take me through her day using the perspectives of people she encounters.
The year is 2030 Technology has automated most low skill jobs. You are a sixteen year old looking for their first job in a world that doesn't need you.
The spaceship was programmed to take you to the colony. When you wake from cryo-sleep you find yourself somewhere very different.
I should have never stepped foot into Wal-Mart.

20 years in the future, the Earth is extremely overpopulated, and resources are limited. As a result, the American government begins to execute people based on whether they feel a person's skill is important or beneficial.
Scientists are now able to separate a body from a soul. You, in the prime years of your life, now are a target for old souls who desire your youth and health.
Is it possible to invoke sensations with words?
